# Geda Real Estate

> Geda is a licensed real estate agent in Ontario, registered with Royal LePage First Contact in Barrie, helping clients buy, sell and lease homes across Barrie & Simcoe County.

## Pages

- [Home](https://gedarealestate.ca/#/home): Licensed real estate agent — buying, selling and leasing in Barrie & Simcoe County.
- [Meet Geda](https://gedarealestate.ca/#/meet-geda): About Geda, licensed agent with Royal LePage First Contact.
- [Buy & Sell](https://gedarealestate.ca/#/buy-sell): Buying, selling and leasing services, done personally.
- [Home Evaluation](https://gedarealestate.ca/#/home-evaluation): Free home evaluation — no obligation, no instant online price estimate.
- [Areas](https://gedarealestate.ca/#/areas): Barrie, Innisfil, Oro-Medonte, Orillia, Wasaga Beach, Springwater and Essa.
- [How I Work](https://gedarealestate.ca/#/how-i-work): Four-step process and values — Love, On Fire, Excellence, Growth, Innovation, WOW.
- [Contact](https://gedarealestate.ca/#/contact): Get in touch about buying, selling, leasing or a free home evaluation.
